name: election-assistant
description: A smart, interactive web application that helps users understand the election process, timelines, and terminology, built for the Google Prompting War competition.

scripts.build: terser app.js -o app.min.js && cleancss -o style.min.css style.css && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('config.js', 'export const GEMINI_API_KEY = \"' + process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY + '\";')"
